about: Cold Lake is a city in northeastern Alberta on the south shore of Cold Lake, one of the province’s largest lakes, beside 4 Wing Cold Lake (CFB Cold Lake). Military aviation, lake recreation, and a service role for surrounding lakeland communities shape the place. Highways 28 and 55 meet near the city. About 15,000 people live in Cold Lake.
